Deals increased damage to Runners. Damage dealt will change based on the enemies' HP. This will deal a fixed percentage of damage and will not increase due to a critical hit. skills.name: Ice Ball

skills.detail:
When You Have a Treasure Area:
A mid-range multiple hit area attack with a chance to inflict Ice Ball state. Creates a shield that blocks close-range enemies' attacks and movement. Transforms your Treasure Area into a Chilly-Chilly Treasure Area (up to 5 locations). Chilly-Chilly Treasure Areas can damage enemies within a certain area and have a chance to inflict Ice Ball state. The Chilly-Chilly transformation will disappear after the Treasure is captured, after a certain amount of time passes, or after you are KO'd.

When You Have No Treasure Area:
A mid-range area attack with a chance to inflict Ice Ball state. Creates a shield that blocks close-range enemies' attacks and movement.

The shield will disappear after it receives a certain amount of damage or after a certain amount of time passes. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
